resourcePolicy.importantDistinction: The fixed 27-case recorder retains all existing counters/caps unchanged. Separate reviewed unit work bounds preserve entire existing named functions, including larger workloads. These units emit no PCM; no recorder acceptance or universal RSS guarantee is inferred. Unit execution is still unreleased pending array/scratch verification and a reviewed log-only/RSS host adapter.

separateReviewedUnitWorkBounds.scope: whole immutable original unit functions; not recorder counter acceptance; no counts/rates/tails/tolerances shortened

proposedUnitHostBounds.RSSMonitorSourceAndSyntheticProof: required before execution release; observed OS RSS, not a claim of instantaneous hard ceiling

hostPlan.native: existing absolute native module + exactly one anchored existing test name per child, count1,v,timeout25; unchanged bounded_child supervisor28s and log256KiB; retain all raw logs/receipts
hostPlan.actualWasm: existing WASM module, pinned Node26/runtime, unchanged closedFS and post-exit helpers; separately review a new log-only host adapter with exact test whitelist and base BUILD/module/runtime hashes. No PCM file is expected; require no file open/data, clean Go exit and exact started/PASS log admission. Existing frozen fixture child is hard-coded and must not be edited or reused as a general gate child.
hostPlan.oldScreen: entry exists in all four compiled modules; any future screen adapter is host-only and separately reviewed. This is no performance release.
hostPlan.notIncluded: No studio_stress, AR, new .source-only Go controls, benchmark, profiler, UI/E2E or cross-target normalization command
